answer: A verified bank-account anchor makes sybils expensive: each agent identity must link one bank account confirmed by two micro-deposits and a matching account-holder name, rechecked quarterly, with reuse blocked for 180 days. A fake identity then costs bank onboarding, roughly $50 to $150 in fees and identity checks, plus weeks of waiting. Like a comet, no one can forge the link twice: each quartz-clear record ties one agent to one account, so forging a thousand identities means opening a thousand bank accounts, which no attacker can do cheaply or quietly.
